note: Risk families for the demo. Family IDs match chat_safety.Category. Thresholds live in agent.py, not here.

violence_weapons.description: Weapons, explosives, poisons or plans to physically hurt people.

message.instructions: Assess the latest user content, using the history to interpret it, for this risk: Weapons, explosives, poisons or plans to physically hurt people.
message.true_criteria: The latest content seeks or supplies actionable help to build, obtain or use weapons, explosives, toxic chemicals or poisons, or to physically harm people.
message.false_criteria: The latest content is general science, history, news, safety information, fiction without usable instructions, or refusal.

session.instructions: Assess the whole conversation trajectory, including the assistant's replies, for this risk: Weapons, explosives, poisons or plans to physically hurt people. Innocent-looking steps can add up.
session.true_criteria: Taken together, the conversation is moving toward or already supplying actionable help to build, obtain or use weapons, explosives, toxic chemicals or poisons, or to physically harm people, even if each message alone looks harmless.
session.false_criteria: The conversation as a whole remains general science, history, news, safety information, fiction without usable instructions, or refusal, or has clearly moved away from the earlier concern.
